title: Hide AFK from Tab List
description: Client-side Fabric mod that filters AFK players from the tab list. Toggle with a keybind to declutter your player list on busy servers.
body:
# Hide AFK from Tab List

A lightweight **client-side** Fabric mod that lets you filter out AFK players from the tab list (player list). Perfect for busy multiplayer servers where the player list gets cluttered with inactive players.

## Features

- **One-Key Toggle** - Instantly show/hide AFK players
- **Tag-Based Detection** - Filters players with "AFK" in their display name or tab list entry
- **Lightweight** - Minimal performance impact, client-side only
- **Configurable Keybind** - Change the toggle key in Minecraft controls

## How to Use

1. Join any multiplayer server
2. Press **F6** (default) to toggle AFK player visibility
3. AFK players will be hidden from your tab list
4. Press **F6** again to show all players

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.4+
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0+
- Fabric API

## Configuration

The keybind can be changed in:
**Options > Controls > Key Binds > Hide AFK from Tab List**

## How It Works

The mod scans player entries in the tab list and hides those containing "AFK" (case-insensitive) in their name or display text. This works with most server AFK plugins that add an AFK tag or prefix to player names.

## Compatibility

- Works with most multiplayer servers
- Compatible with other client-side mods
- Works with server AFK plugins (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)
- Server-side installation not required
